name: hud_ui_save_game_dialog_init_layout
description: HudUiSaveGameDialog::InitLayout constructs the save-game dialog, initializes the game-name input and list rows, attempts to load SAVE_GAME_DIALOG from dialog.zrd, then resets selection.
known_limits: No local VC5 byte target currently covers 0x434680. Binary Ninja shows MSVC EH cleanup-state code and array-constructor glue around the child list-item array, so tier S should be attempted as a save/load dialog constructor cluster rather than as an isolated function.

The smoke patches HudUiBackground::LoadFromZrd to return no loaded section, so it covers the constructor, game-name input setup, list-row initialization, selected-index reset, and cleanup path without exercising BindWidgetByName or BindPrimitiveNodeToElement.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x434680 shows HudUiBackground construction, delete/back/next/prev button construction, HudUiNumericTextInput base construction, 20-byte text allocation, input activation, raw keyboard capture, nine HudUiSaveLoadListItem constructions through MSVC array-constructor glue, fileEntries zeroing, primary action construction, LoadFromZrd("dialog.zrd", "SAVE_GAME_DIALOG", 0), InitializeFileEntries, SetSelectedEntryIndex(-1), and return self.

The native smoke patches only the background load call to the missing-resource path, verifies the exact load arguments, returned self pointer, allocated empty game-name buffer with capacity 20, active input state, selected index -1, initialized list-row layoutY values, hidden list rows after selection reset, and then runs the real save-game dialog destructor.
